question: What is the maximum lump sum group life cover a member can have?

result.question: What is the maximum lump sum group life cover a member can have?
result.answer: The maximum lump sum group life cover per member is R25 000 000, and this cap applies regardless of the member's salary or the cover multiple the scheme uses.

hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text: Kestrel Group Life Assurance pays a lump sum to a member's nominated beneficiaries if the member dies while covered under a participating employer's scheme. Cover is provided under a group policy issued to the employer or retirement fund.

hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text:
- Members must be permanent employees of the participating employer.
- The maximum entry age is 64. Cover ends at the scheme's normal retirement age, or age 65 at the latest.
- Members must be actively at work on the date cover starts. If not, cover starts on the date they return to full duties.

question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?

result.question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?
result.answer: The member must apply within 60 days of leaving service (and must have left before normal retirement age); no medical evidence is needed. The continuation cover is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.

citations.label: c1
citations.quote: A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age may apply to continue their life cover on an individual Kestrel policy without providing medical evidence. The application must be received within 60 days of leaving service. Cover under the continuation option is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.
citations.supports: 60-day application deadline after leaving service, and cover limited to the lower of group cover and R5 000 000
citations.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)

caveats: This is the general rule; the underwriting or scheme administrator confirms the member's actual group cover amount and whether the individual case qualifies.

Also written as: 5000000, R5000000

result.answer: For a scheme with 1 200 members, the disability income free cover limit is R120 000 per month. This is band 6 of the 2026 Free Cover Limits table, which applies to schemes with 1 000 or more members.

question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?

result.question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?
result.answer: Under disability Option C, a member earning R50 000 a month would receive R42 500 a month. Option C pays 100% of the first R20 000 of monthly salary plus 75% of the balance, which is below the R300 000 maximum monthly benefit. Salary means monthly pensionable salary at the date disability started, and the benefit is subject to a 3-month waiting period with a fixed 5% annual escalation. This is the general rule applied to the example figure; the claims or underwriting team confirms the amount for an individual claim.

question: Until what age is the disability income benefit paid?

result.question: Until what age is the disability income benefit paid?
result.answer: The disability income benefit is paid monthly in arrears until the earliest of three events: the member's recovery, the member's death, or the member reaching age 65. So age 65 is the latest age it runs to, and it stops earlier if the member recovers or dies first.

question: What is the premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for a scheme with 150 members?

result.question: What is the premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for a scheme with 150 members?
result.answer: The documents do not give a premium rate per R1 000 of life cover. The 2026 Group Life Product Guide quotes premiums on a different basis: they are a percentage of the total annual salary bill of covered members, guaranteed for 2 years from the scheme commencement or review date and then reviewed on scheme experience. The actual rate for a 150-member scheme would come from the quote issued to the employer — the underwriting team can help.
result.reason: The documents do not state a premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for any scheme size, including 150 members; the premium section states rates are quoted as a percentage of the total annual salary bill. question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?

result.question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?
result.answer: A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age has 60 days from leaving to apply for the continuation option, which lets them keep life cover on an individual Kestrel policy without medical evidence. The continuation cover is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000. Note this applies to life cover, not the funeral benefit.

citations.label: c1
citations.quote: A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age may apply to continue their life cover on an individual Kestrel policy without providing medical evidence. The application must be received within 60 days of leaving service. Cover under the continuation option is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.
citations.supports: Time limit of 60 days and cover limit of the lower of group cover and R5 000 000, plus the conditions (before normal retirement age, no medical evidence, life cover only).
citations.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)

caveats: The continuation option found covers life cover under the group life guide; the documents do not state a continuation option for the group disability income or funeral benefit.

question: What is the group life free cover limit for a scheme with 320 members?

result.question: What is the group life free cover limit for a scheme with 320 members?
result.answer: The group life free cover limit for a scheme with 320 members is R 5 000 000. A scheme of 320 members falls in Band 4, which covers schemes of 250 to 499 members; that band's group life free cover limit is R 5 000 000. (The same band's disability income free cover limit is R 70 000 per month, if that comes up.)

question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?

result.question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?
result.answer: Under disability Option C, a member earning R50 000 a month would receive a monthly benefit of R42 500: 100% of the first R20 000 of monthly salary plus 75% of the balance. That is below the Option C maximum monthly benefit of R300 000, so the cap does not apply. (This answer uses the 2026 disability income guide and the employer-selected Option C formula; the benefit is based on the member's monthly pensionable salary at the date disability started.)

question: What is the premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for a scheme with 150 members?

result.question: What is the premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for a scheme with 150 members?
result.answer: The approved documents do not give a premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for a scheme of 150 members. The 2026 Group Life Product Guide says premiums on this product are expressed as a percentage of the total annual salary bill of covered members, not as a rate per R1 000 of cover, and premium rates are guaranteed for 2 years from the scheme commencement or review date and are then reviewed based on scheme experience. The scheme-size tables in the documents only set free cover limits, not premium rates. For the actual rate for this scheme, please contact Kestrel underwriting or the broker or scheme administrator.

hit.title: Claims Frequently Asked Questions (updated March 2026)
hit.locator: section "How long does it take to assess a claim?"
heading_path: How long does it take to assess a claim?
hit.text: Kestrel aims to make a decision on group life claims within 10 working days of receiving all required documents. Disability claims may take longer because medical information may need to be obtained. Funeral claims are paid within 48 hours of receiving complete documents.

hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text: The death of a member must be notified to Kestrel within 6 months of the date of death. Claims notified later may be declined. See the Kestrel Claims FAQ for the documents required.

hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text: Kestrel Group Life Assurance pays a lump sum to a member's nominated beneficiaries if the member dies while covered under a participating employer's scheme. Cover is provided under a group policy issued to the employer or retirement fund.

hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text:
- Members must be permanent employees of the participating employer.
- The maximum entry age is 64. Cover ends at the scheme's normal retirement age, or age 65 at the latest.
- Members must be actively at work on the date cover starts. If not, cover starts on the date they return to full duties.

question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?

result.question: A member is leaving their employer. How long do they have to take up the continuation option, and up to what amount of cover?
result.answer: A member who leaves the employer's service before normal retirement age must apply for the continuation option within 60 days of leaving service, then the cover can continue on an individual Kestrel policy without medical evidence. The continuation cover is limited to the lower of the member's group cover and R5 000 000.

hit.title: Underwriting Free Cover Limits (effective 1 January 2026)
hit.text:
1. Schemes with fewer than 10 members are fully underwritten; no free cover limit applies.
2. The free cover limit is set at scheme inception and reviewed at each annual review date based on the number of members at that date.
3. Cover above the free cover limit requires medical evidence and is subject to underwriting acceptance.
4. Free cover limits apply only to members who are actively at work when cover starts.

question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?

result.question: Under disability Option C, what monthly benefit would a member earning R50 000 a month receive?
result.answer: Under Option C, a member earning R50 000 a month would receive R42 500 per month. This is 100% of the first R20 000 of monthly salary (R20 000) plus 75% of the balance (75% of R30 000 = R22 500), which is below the R300 000 maximum monthly benefit. The salary used is the member's monthly pensionable salary at the date the disability started.

question: Until what age is the disability income benefit paid?

result.question: Until what age is the disability income benefit paid?
result.answer: The Group Disability Income Benefit is paid until the member reaches age 65, but it stops earlier if the member recovers or dies — it is paid "until the earliest of: the member's recovery, the member's death, or the member reaching age 65".

question: What documents are needed to submit a disability claim?

result.question: What documents are needed to submit a disability claim?
result.answer: For a disability claim you need: a completed Kestrel disability claim form (employer section and member section), a medical report from the treating doctor, the member's last 3 payslips, and a certified copy of the member's ID document. question: What is the premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for a scheme with 150 members?

result.question: What is the premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for a scheme with 150 members?
result.answer: The approved documents do not state a premium rate per R1 000 of life cover for any scheme size, so there is no figure I can give for a 150-member scheme. The only premium basis the documents describe is that premiums are expressed as a percentage of the total annual salary bill of covered members, with rates guaranteed for 2 years from commencement or review. For an actual rate, ask underwriting to quote the scheme.
result.reason: The approved documents contain no rate card and no premium rate expressed per R1 000 of life cover, whether tied to member numbers or not. The only pricing basis stated is a percentage of the total annual salary bill; a rate for a 150-member scheme must come from underwriting or a formal quotation.

question: How long does Kestrel take to make a decision on a group life claim?

result.question: How long does Kestrel take to make a decision on a group life claim?
result.answer: Kestrel aims to make a decision on group life claims within 10 working days of receiving all the required documents. This is a target, not a guarantee, and the clock starts only once all documents are in.

hit.locator: section "How long does it take to assess a claim?"
heading_path: How long does it take to assess a claim?
hit.text: Kestrel aims to make a decision on group life claims within 10 working days of receiving all required documents. Disability claims may take longer because medical information may need to be obtained. Funeral claims are paid within 48 hours of receiving complete documents.

hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text: The death of a member must be notified to Kestrel within 6 months of the date of death. Claims notified later may be declined. See the Kestrel Claims FAQ for the documents required.

hit.title: Group Disability Income Benefit Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
heading_path: Group Disability Income Benefit: Product Guide
hit.text: Claims should be submitted as soon as possible and no later than 3 months after the end of the waiting period. See the Kestrel Claims FAQ for the documents required.

hit.title: Group Funeral Benefit Scheme Rules (Version 2026.1)
hit.text: Funeral claims are paid within 48 hours of Kestrel receiving all the required documents.

hit.title: Claims Frequently Asked Questions (updated March 2026)

heading_path: What if I am unhappy with a claim decision?
hit.text: You can ask for the decision to be reviewed by writing to complaints@kestrel-assurance.example within 90 days of the decision. If you are still not satisfied, you may refer the matter to the long-term insurance ombud.

hit.title: Group Life Assurance Product Guide (Version 2026.1)
hit.text: Kestrel Group Life Assurance pays a lump sum to a member's nominated beneficiaries if the member dies while covered under a participating employer's scheme. Cover is provided under a group policy issued to the employer or retirement fund.
